title: Quantile-Based Skewness for Fuzzy Numbers with Probabilistic Foundations: With an Application in Portfolio Optimization
summary: This paper introduces a novel parameter free skewness coefficient for fuzzy numbers, addressing a critical gap in quantifying asymmetry under imprecision. Existing fuzzy literature substitutes membership functions for probability density functions in moment-based skewness, lacking rigorous theoretical grounding. Our coefficient, however, rigorously establishes a probabilistic foundation, making it both probabilistically meaningful and fully compliant with the semantics of fuzzy set theory.
